items.title: Important Anthropic Settlement Update: Check Your Claim by Friday, November 20
items.excerpt: First payments from the Bartz v. Anthropic settlement are expected the week of November 23; they will be about 70 percent of what each author is owed, and claimants must check their claims by November 20.
items.rationale: Most actionable item in the pool: a hard Nov 20 deadline and the first payout date and size for authors in the $1.5B settlement, straight from the Authors Guild.

items.title: AI firms turning books into toilet paper, committee told
items.excerpt: An Oireachtas committee heard AI companies are buying and destroying physical books to scan them for training data, as Irish writers press for copyright protections.
items.rationale: The bulk-buying of books for AI scanning reaches a national parliament: Irish writers testify before an Oireachtas committee and ask for copyright protections.

items.title: 투고가 쏟아진다…출판계도 AI 원고에 골머리
items.excerpt: 출판사 원고 투고가 작년 대비 40% 넘게 늘었고, 특히 에세이 분야에서 AI로 쓴 것으로 보이는 원고가 급증해 출판계가 검토 부담을 호소하고 있다.
items.rationale: New Korean data: manuscript submissions are up more than 40% year on year, driven by apparently AI-written essays, and editors are struggling with the review load.

items.title: How 'I love You' becomes 'The moon is beautiful, isn't it?': The Craft of Translation and the limits of AI
items.excerpt: Manga translators and many U.S. publishers reject AI translation for missing nuance and visual context, while some Japanese companies push AI-assisted localization to speed releases.
items.rationale: Adds comics and translation to the mix: practitioners explain where AI manga localization fails, set against Japanese publishers pushing for speed.

items.title: "AI가 사용하는 콘텐츠, 함께 비용 받아내자"…美 3000여 권리자 결속
items.excerpt: 미국 권리자 3000여 곳이 AI 콘텐츠 이용료 공동 징수에 나서 야후 스카웃과 첫 유료 계약을 맺었고, 한국 출판계도 AI 데이터 기업 5곳과 협약했다.
items.rationale: Collective licensing in practice: about 3,000 U.S. rights holders sign their first paid AI-usage deal (Yahoo Scout), and Korean publishers sign data deals.

https://authorsguild.org/news/anthropic-.new_action: Official update on the Bartz v. Anthropic settlement: first payments scheduled for the week of Nov 23 at about 70% of each author's share, with a Nov 20 deadline to check claims (earlier cards covered claim notices, payout delay and objections).
